title: Categorical closed-fibre diagram before flatness descent
statement: Let R, S, S' be commutative rings with R local, let R -> S -> S' be ring maps, and let M be an S'-module with its compatible restricted S-action. Let X be a Noetherian local model tower for these rings and module [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-local-model-tower], indexed by its nonempty directed preorder I. Write Q_i = S_i/m_i S_i and E_i = Q_i tensor_(S_i) N_i, where m_i is the maximal ideal of R_i; put Q = S/m_R S and E = Q tensor_S M. There exist diagrams A,B:I -> CommRingCat and D:I -> AddCommGrpCat, stage B_i-module structures on D_i, compatible local ring maps phi_i:A_i -> B_i, and a ring map psi:colim A -> colim B with a (colim B)-module structure on colim D, such that: (1) A_i and B_i are Noetherian local rings, D_i is finite over B_i, all ring transitions are local, their squares with phi commute, all module transitions are semilinear, psi intertwines the ring colimit coprojections, and the module colimit coprojections are semilinear; (2) for every transition i -> j, the canonical map B_i tensor_(A_i) A_j -> B_j is a localization, specified on pure tensors by b tensor a -> image(b) phi_j(a), and B_j tensor_(B_i) D_i -> D_j is a linear equivalence specified by b tensor x -> b image(x); (3) for every i there are a ring equivalence A_i -> Q_i and an additive equivalence D_i -> E_i intertwining the restricted A_i-action and the Q_i-action; (4) there are a ring equivalence colim A -> Q and an additive equivalence colim D -> E intertwining the action restricted along psi and the Q-action. Ring diagram universes are max(u,v,w), and the group diagram universe is max(u,v,w,t), with lifts where required. No flatness hypothesis or flat-stage conclusion is part of this assertion.

source.place: Algebra, Tag 00R7 (lemma-criterion-flatness-fibre), paragraph beginning with the colimit of the maximal ideals, quotient systems and transitions before the second application of Tag 00R6; checked at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00R7.

proof.text: Use the explicitly constructed quotient systems of def-weil-pbc-noetherian-local-model-tower-fiber-system. Its proved APIs give functor laws, the actual stage actions, locality and Noetherianity, finite stage modules, local quotient transitions, the natural squares, semilinearity, the actual induced colimit ring map, compatible stage fibre equivalences and the module base-change transition equivalences.

Apply lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-local-model-tower-fiber-localization to these fixed ring functors to obtain the quotient localization transitions and their pure-tensor formula. This is proved using the explicit surjective tensor quotient map and IsLocalization.of_surjective.

Apply lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-local-model-tower-fiber-colimit to obtain its uniquely determined colimit module action, semilinear coprojections and compatible closed-fibre comparisons. Assemble all witnesses and conjunctions, taking the stage ring comparison to be RingEquiv.refl and the stage additive comparison to be the explicitly constructed fiberDEquiv.

proof_origin.note: All three steps are implemented and proved: actual quotient/tensor data, quotient localization comparisons, ring and group colimits, transported scalar action and uniqueness. No remaining sorry.

theorem NoetherianLocalModelTower.exists_fiber_diagram
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {S' : Type w} {M : Type t}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing S'] [IsLocalRing R] [AddCommGroup M]
    [Algebra R S] [Algebra S S'] [Module S' M] [Module S M]
    [IsScalarTower S S' M]
    (X : NoetherianLocalModelTower R S S' M) :
    letI := X.preorder
    letI := X.commR
    letI := X.commS
    letI := X.localR
    letI := X.algRS
    letI := X.addN
    letI := X.moduleS
    ∃ (A B : X.ι ⥤ CommRingCat.{max u v w})
      (D : X.ι ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w t})
      (act : ∀ i, Module (B.obj i) (D.obj i)),
    letI := act
    ∃ (φ : ∀ i, A.obj i →+* B.obj i)
      (ψ : (colimit A : CommRingCat.{max u v w}) →+*
        (colimit B : CommRingCat.{max u v w}))
      (limitAct : Module (colimit B : CommRingCat.{max u v w})
        (colimit D : AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w t})),
    letI := limitAct
    (∀ i, IsLocalRing (A.obj i)) ∧
    (∀ i, IsLocalRing (B.obj i)) ∧
    (∀ i, IsNoetherianRing (A.obj i)) ∧
    (∀ i, IsNoetherianRing (B.obj i)) ∧
    (∀ i, Module.Finite (B.obj i) (D.obj i)) ∧
    (∀ i, IsLocalHom (φ i)) ∧
    (∀ (i j : X.ι) (f : i ⟶ j), IsLocalHom (A.map f).hom) ∧
    (∀ (i j : X.ι) (f : i ⟶ j), IsLocalHom (B.map f).hom) ∧
    (∀ (i j : X.ι) (f : i ⟶ j),
      (B.map f).hom.comp (φ i) = (φ j).comp (A.map f).hom) ∧
    (∀ (i j : X.ι) (f : i ⟶ j) (b : B.obj i) (x : D.obj i),
      (D.map f).hom (b • x) = (B.map f).hom b • (D.map f).hom x) ∧
    (∀ i, ψ.comp (colimit.ι A i).hom = (colimit.ι B i).hom.comp (φ i)) ∧
    (∀ (i : X.ι) (b : B.obj i) (x : D.obj i),
      (colimit.ι D i).hom (b • x) = (colimit.ι B i).hom b • (colimit.ι D i).hom x) ∧
    (∀ (i j : X.ι) (f : i ⟶ j),
      letI := (φ i).toAlgebra
      letI := (A.map f).hom.toAlgebra
      ∃ (q : B.obj i ⊗[A.obj i] A.obj j →+* B.obj j)
        (U : Submonoid (B.obj i ⊗[A.obj i] A.obj j)),
        (∀ (b : B.obj i) (a : A.obj j),
          q (b ⊗ₜ[A.obj i] a) = (B.map f).hom b * φ j a) ∧
        (letI := q.toAlgebra; IsLocalization U (B.obj j))) ∧
    (∀ (i j : X.ι) (f : i ⟶ j),
      letI := (B.map f).hom.toAlgebra
      ∃ e : (B.obj j ⊗[B.obj i] D.obj i) ≃ₗ[B.obj j] D.obj j,
        ∀ (b : B.obj j) (x : D.obj i),
          e (b ⊗ₜ[B.obj i] x) = b • (D.map f).hom x) ∧
    (∀ i, ∃
      (eA : A.obj i ≃+*
        (X.S₀ i ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap (X.R₀ i) (X.S₀ i))
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.R₀ i))))
      (eD : D.obj i ≃+
        ((X.S₀ i ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap (X.R₀ i) (X.S₀ i))
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.R₀ i))) ⊗[X.S₀ i] X.N₀ i)),
      letI := Module.compHom (D.obj i) (φ i)
      ∀ a x, eD (a • x) = eA a • eD x) ∧
    (∃
      (eA : (colimit A : CommRingCat.{max u v w}) ≃+*
        (S ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap R S) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)))
      (eD : (colimit D : AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w t}) ≃+
        ((S ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap R S) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)) ⊗[S] M)),
      letI := Module.compHom (colimit D : AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w t}) ψ
      ∀ a x, eD (a • x) = eA a • eD x)
